resourceSchemas.quantity: per-card GPU record: LWC world-space OBB origin, world->local rotation, mesh-cards axes/origin/extent, low- and high-res page-table spans, visibility flags and average texel size
resourceSchemas.units: floats in world units (cm) for origin/extent/texel size; integer indices, res-level bias bytes, 4-bit direction/channel fields and 1-bit flags
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: world space for Origin/rotation (double-float split); mesh-cards local space for MeshCardsOrigin/Extent; card page-table index space for offsets

storage.format: float4[7] per card (112 B/card); RDG buffer element is 16 B because ResizeStructuredBufferIfNeeded allocates 16-B elements

fields.name: WorldPositionHigh
fields.decode: high 3 components of the world-space OBB origin (LWC high part)

fields.name: ResLevelToResLevelXYBiasX
fields.decode: Packed0W bits[0:7]; subtracted from the scalar ResLevel to obtain per-axis X: ResLevelXY.x = ResLevel - bias.x

fields.name: AxisAlignedDirection
fields.decode: Packed0W bits[16:19]; index 0..5 selecting one of the six axis-aligned card directions

fields.name: LightingChannelMask
fields.decode: Packed0W bits[20:23]; 4 lighting-channel bits copied from the primitive group (0xF when unknown)

fields.name: bVisible
fields.decode: Packed0W bit24; card allocated and visible after culling

fields.name: WorldToLocalRotationRow0
fields.decode: Vector1.xyz; rows of the world->local rotation

fields.name: SizeInPagesX
fields.decode: Vector4.x bits[0:15]; low-res mip size in pages

fields.name: PageTableOffset
fields.decode: Vector4.y; first page-table entry of the low-res mip

fields.name: HiResSizeInPagesX
fields.decode: Vector4.z bits[0:15]; high-res (specular) mip size in pages

fields.name: PackedMeshCardsAxes
fields.decode: Vector5.w; 3 x 3-bit axis-shuffle opcodes, positive/negative flips in bits 0/3/6 (see ShuffleAxes)

fields.name: TexelSize
fields.decode: Vector6.w; average world-space texel size of always-resident pages

transforms.name: unpackCardData
transforms.expression: BaseOffset = CardId*7; Origin = DFHackToFloat(MakeDFVector3(V0.xyz, float3(V1.w,V2.w,V3.w))); rows = V1.xyz,V2.xyz,V3.xyz

transforms.name: unpackPacked0W
transforms.expression: bVisible=(w>>24)&1; bHeightfield=(w>>25)&1; bFarField=(w>>26)&1; Dir=(w>>16)&0xF; Channel=(w>>20)&0xF; BiasXY=(w&0xFF,(w>>8)&0xFF)

transforms.name: unpackMeshCardsAxes
transforms.expression: LocalExtent = ShuffleAxesNoFlip(MeshCardsExtent, PackedMeshCardsAxes); LocalExtent.z = max(LocalExtent.z, 1)

mathTerms: 7 float4 per card = 112 B semantic stride; the RDG descriptor reports 16 B/element because ResizeStructuredBufferIfNeeded uses 16-B allocation elements (512 elements = 8192 B capacity in this capture, i.e. floor(512/7)=73 cards maximum and, because RoundUpToPowerOfTwo(7N)=512, NumCardEntries in [37,73])
ResLevelToResLevelXYBias is two 8-bit bytes packed in word 0; Packed0W bits 27-31 are unused
PackedMeshCardsAxes bits[0],[3],[6] are sign flips; bits[1:2],[4:5],[7:8] are the axis permutation opcode
gaps: LWC decode is not byte-exact: MakeDFVector3/DFHackToFloat reconstructs a float from the high/low split, but the exact high/low split function is not expanded here.
PackedMeshCardsAxes opcode meaning (ShuffleAxesNoFlip switch, LumenCardCommon.ush:40-66) is enumerated in source but not reduced to a closed-form table.
Capacity in the capture descriptor is not a live-card count: valid float4 = 7*NumCardEntries; the rounded-up tail is uninitialized/stale.
If r.LumenScene.SurfaceCache.Feedback.HighResPages is off, the high-res fields are still allocated but not used for page mapping.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-mesh-cards record: LWC world origin, world->local rotation rows, first card index, card count plus flags, and six axis card-lookup bitmasks
resourceSchemas.units: world units (cm), rotation unitless, indices, bitmasks
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: world space (double-float split) and mesh-cards local space

storage.format: float4[6] per mesh-cards record (96 B/record); RDG allocation element 16 B

fields.name: WorldOriginHigh
fields.decode: V0.xyz; high part of the mesh-cards world origin

fields.name: CardOffset
fields.decode: V4.x = MeshCards.FirstCardIndex; first index into Lumen.Cards

fields.name: CardLookup0
fields.decode: V4.z; OR bitmask of local card indices whose card faces -X

transforms.name: unpackMeshCards
transforms.expression: BaseOffset = MeshCardsId*6; Origin = DFHackToFloat(MakeDFVector3(V0.xyz, float3(V1.w,V2.w,V3.w))); CardMask = OR over axes CardLookup[2*axis + sign]

transforms.name: unpackFlags
transforms.expression: NumCards = V4.y & 0xFFFF; bHeightfield = (V4.y & 0x10000)!=0; bMostlyTwoSided = (V4.y & 0x20000)!=0

mathTerms: 6 float4 per mesh-cards record = 96 B semantic stride; capture capacity 64 float4 = 1024 B means at most floor(64/6)=10 complete records (NumMeshCards in [6,10] because RoundUpToPowerOfTwo(6*N)=64)
CardLookup bits index local card index: CardIndex = CardOffset + bitIndex
V4.y bits 18-31 are unused (only bit16 bHeightfield and bit17 bMostlyTwoSided are defined)
gaps: World origin uses the same unexpanded LWC DF high/low reconstruction as Lumen.Cards.
The capture capacity is an upper bound on record count, not the live NumMeshCards (the rounded tail is not initialized).
CardLookup bits are built with BitMask = 1 << LocalCardIndex (uint32); a local card index >= 32 cannot be represented in this mask, and the shift is undefined for >=32 (LumenMeshCards.cpp:1609-1610).

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-heightfield world-space AABB (LWC center + extent) and the mesh-cards index that owns its single card

storage.format: float4[3] per heightfield (48 B/record); RDG allocation element 16 B

fields.name: BoundsCenterHigh
fields.decode: OutData[0].xyz; high part of world AABB center

fields.name: MeshCardsIndex
fields.decode: OutData[0].w reinterpreted as uint; 0xFFFFFFFF when Heightfield.MeshCardsIndex < 0

fields.name: BoundsCenterLow
fields.decode: OutData[1].xyz; low part of world AABB center

transforms.name: unpackHeightfield
transforms.expression: Center = MakeDFVector3(V0.xyz, V1.xyz); Extent = V2.xyz; bValid = MeshCardsIndex < NumMeshCards

mathTerms: 3 float4 = 48 B per heightfield
Capture capacity is 16 B = one float4, which is less than one 48-B record, so the capture contains 0 valid heightfield records; this is the empty-buffer minimum (RoundUpToPowerOfTwo(0)=1)
gaps: LWC center reconstruction is not expanded (DFHackToFloat/MakeDFVector3).
bValid is derived from MeshCardsIndex < NumMeshCards; the buffer itself has no explicit valid flag.
Capture capacity 16 B cannot hold one record; do not read a heightfield from this capture.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-GPUScene-instance mapping to the mesh-cards record index used to resolve cards for SDF/HWRT surface-cache sampling

fields.name: MeshCardsIndex
fields.decode: Load(4*SceneInstanceIndex); value 0xFFFFFFFF means the instance has no Lumen mesh cards; otherwise it is an index into Lumen.MeshCards

transforms.name: load
transforms.expression: MeshCardsIndex = SceneInstanceIndexToMeshCardsIndexBuffer.Load(4 * SceneInstanceIndex)

mathTerms: capacity = max(RoundUpToPowerOfTwo(GPUScene.InstanceIdUpperBound),1024) elements
uploaded value = GetMeshCardsIndex(...) which returns -1 when the primitive has no Lumen primitive group, stored as 0xFFFFFFFF
gaps: The capture capacity is 1024 elements, exactly the minimum; live instance count is not encoded in the descriptor.
Only the loaded uint is decoded; the producer's -1 -> 0xFFFFFFFF conversion is an int32 bit pattern, not a float.

resourceSchemas.quantity: captured card surface albedo (sqrt-encoded linear diffuse color in RGB) and coverage/opacity (A)
resourceSchemas.units: linear color (sqrt-encoded, UNORM8); alpha = opacity 0 or 1
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: card-capture atlas texel space (2D, mirrored card UV)

fields.name: Opacity
fields.decode: material coverage/opacity; 0 or 1 in the source (masked/opaque coverage), not used by the lighting combine

transforms.name: decodeAlbedo
transforms.expression: A_linear = ApplyDiffuseColorBoost((code/255)^2, DiffuseColorBoost); then A = A*View.DiffuseOverrideParameter.w + View.DiffuseOverrideParameter.xyz

transforms.name: storeAlbedo
transforms.expression: Target0 = float4(sqrt(DiffuseColor), Opacity)

mathTerms: sqrt encode, square decode; 8-bit quantization per channel
alpha is coverage/opacity, not used as a lighting channel
gaps: The capture atlas is uncompressed RGBA8 in this capture; the surface-cache copy may compress it to BC7, so the on-disk surface-cache bytes need a BC7 decoder (not this resource).
DiffuseColorBoost and View.DiffuseOverrideParameter are pass/view inputs; without them the stored sqrt color is still exact but the final albedo is not unique.

resourceSchemas.quantity: card-space normal XY (encoded unorm) and a validity flag; Z is reconstructed
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: card space (capture view axes are the card OBB axes; the shader writes view-space normal)

fields.name: bValid
fields.decode: written as 1 for captured texels; the surface-cache copy tests this alpha > 0.5 to decide validity

transforms.name: decodeNormal
transforms.expression: N.xy = code.xy*2-1; N.z = sqrt(max(1 - |N.xy|^2, 1e-4)); WorldNormal = normalize(mul(Card.WorldToLocalRotation, N))

transforms.name: storeNormal
transforms.expression: Target1 = float4(CardSpaceNormal.xy*0.5+0.5, 0, 1)

mathTerms: 2-channel 8-bit encoding; z reconstructed with a 1e-4 clamp
the capture view is card-axis aligned, so the view-space normal written by LumenCardBasePass equals card space
gaps: Sign of Z is always positive; back-facing cards are represented by mirrored card UV / card axes, not by a negative Z.
Validity is the alpha of this target, not the depth target.

resourceSchemas.quantity: pre-exposed material emissive radiance (RGB)
resourceSchemas.units: radiance, pre-exposed with CachedLightingPreExposure (linear, HDR float)

fields.name: EmissiveR
fields.decode: R11G11B10 float channel r (5-bit exponent, 6-bit mantissa); decoded by hardware as float

transforms.name: storeEmissive
transforms.expression: Target2.rgb = Emissive * CachedLightingPreExposure; Target2.a = 0

transforms.name: decodeEmissive
transforms.expression: Emissive_physical = stored_rgb * OneOverCachedLightingPreExposure

mathTerms: stored = physical emissive * CachedLightingPreExposure (default 1/16 at 4 EV)
gaps: Exact R11G11B10 rounding is hardware-defined; the stored value is quantized, so byte-exact physical emissive requires the pre-exposure and the hardware rounding.
The surface-cache copy may re-encode this layer as BC6H, which this schema does not decode.

resourceSchemas.quantity: rasterized card depth (hardware depth buffer) plus an unused stencil aspect

formatAlternatives: platform depth-stencil format: D3D12/X24_G8 alias indicates 24-bit depth + 8-bit stencil in 4 B on some platforms, while GPixelFormats[PF_DepthStencil].BlockBytes is 5 on D3D12/D3D11/Metal (D3D12RHI.cpp:136, D3D11Device.cpp:114, MetalRHI.cpp:822); the dump ByteSize uses BlockBytes, so 5 B/texel here is an estimate, not the hardware layout

fields.name: Depth
fields.decode: hardware depth; the Lumen copy pass reads .x and reverses it: card_depth = 1 - depth

fields.name: Stencil
fields.decode: allocated but not written/read by Lumen card capture

transforms.name: decodeCardDepth
transforms.expression: DepthCard = 1 - DepthHW; LocalZ = -(2*DepthCard - 1)*Card.LocalExtent.z

mathTerms: depth is written by rasterization of card geometry in the card ortho view; the pixel shader does not output SV_Depth
surface-cache depth = EncodeSurfaceCacheDepth(1 - depthHW, bValid), with 1.0 reserved invalid
gaps: PF_DepthStencil raw bit layout is platform-selected and not specified by the source; the descriptor's 5 B/texel is GPixelFormats.BlockBytes, not a hardware format.
Stencil is not used by Lumen card capture; its value is undefined for this resource.
Invalid texels hold the clear depth, not a validity sentinel; validity comes from CardCaptureNormalAtlas.a > 0.5 (LumenSurfaceCache.usf:64).

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-captured-page rectangle in the card-capture atlas, used as the rasterizer's instance rect

transforms.name: rasterizeRect
transforms.expression: RectCoord = RectCoordBuffer[InstanceId] * DownsampleFactor; VertexCoord = (VertexId max ? RectCoord.zw : RectCoord.xy); RectUV = RectCoord * InvViewSize.xyxy

mathTerms: one rect per CardPagesToRender entry, in the same order as the page-index upload
capacity = RoundUpToPowerOfTwo(NumRects); valid entries = NumRects
when used for compressed surface-cache copy the rect is consumed with DownsampleFactor=4 and a separate capture-rect UV buffer
gaps: Rect .zw are exclusive max corners, not inclusive; a decoder must subtract Min to get the size.
The buffer has no header/count; the valid count is the pass's NumRects argument, not derivable from the buffer alone.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-captured-page rectangle in the physical surface-cache atlas, used to copy/compress capture texels into the cache
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: physical surface-cache atlas texel space (clamped to >=0)

transforms.name: copyRect
transforms.expression: For compressed layers: WriteCoord/UV uses SurfaceCacheRect scaled by DownsampleFactor=4 and the capture atlas rect as RectUV; for uncompressed copy: rect is used directly

mathTerms: same order as CardPagesToRender
capacity = RoundUpToPowerOfTwo(NumPages); valid entries = NumPages
rects are clamped to the physical atlas, so Min may differ from the capture rect Min
gaps: Valid count is the pass's CardPagesToRender.Num(), not stored in the buffer.
Compressed layers use a 4x downsampled destination, so the same rect means different texel units depending on the layer's compression path.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-capture-rect source-card info for resampling material and history lighting from the previous card layout: two uint4 words per rect
resourceSchemas.units: card index, source card index + flip bit, card UV rect
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: card UV space (rect index space for the outer index)

fields.name: CardIndex
fields.decode: word[2*Rect+0].x: card index for lighting-history resample, or 0xFFFFFFFF when bResampleLastLighting is false (LUMEN_INVALID_CARD_INDEX)

fields.name: SourceCardIndexPlusOne
fields.decode: word[2*Rect+0].y bits[0:30]: (CopyCardIndex+1) when the page does not need render, else 0; the material resample shader computes SourceCardIndex = (y & 0x7fffffff)-1 and skips when it equals 0xFFFFFFFF

fields.name: bAxisXFlipped
fields.decode: word[2*Rect+0].y bit31: flip source CardUV.x before resampling

fields.name: CardUVRect
fields.decode: word[2*Rect+1] reinterpreted as float4: source card UV rect (xy=min, zw=max) used for the material resample

fields.name: UnusedZW
fields.decode: word[2*Rect+0].z/.w are never written by the producer; contents undefined

transforms.name: materialResample
transforms.expression: Packed = Word0.y; Src = (Packed & 0x7fffffff)-1; bFlip = (Packed & 0x80000000)!=0; CardUV = lerp(Word1.xy, Word1.zw, RectUV); if bFlip: CardUV.x = 1-CardUV.x

transforms.name: lightingResample
transforms.expression: CardIndex = Word0.x; skipped when CardIndex == LUMEN_INVALID_CARD_INDEX

mathTerms: 2 uint4 words per rect = 32 B; element count = RoundUpToPowerOfTwo(NumRects*2); valid words = 2*NumRects
word0.x and word0.y are different payloads for two different consumers (lighting vs material resample) and must not be conflated
gaps: word0.z/.w are uninitialized; do not interpret them.
The two consumers use different fields; word0.y's low 31 bits are not a card index directly (it is +1 encoded, 0 means no copy).
Rect order must match CardCaptureRects and the rasterizer instance order; it is not stored in the buffer.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-capture-tile packed (rect index, tile x, tile y) list driving the lighting-history resample compute pass
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: card-capture atlas tile grid (8x8 texels per tile)

fields.name: TileX
fields.decode: bits[0:3]: tile X within the capture rect

fields.name: TileY
fields.decode: bits[4:7]: tile Y within the capture rect

transforms.name: unpack
transforms.expression: TileX = Packed & 0xF; TileY = (Packed>>4)&0xF; RectIndex = (Packed>>8)&0xFFFFFF; TileIndex = GroupId.x

mathTerms: one uint per 8x8 capture tile in rect-major order; NumCaptureTiles = sum(rectWidthInTiles*rectHeightInTiles)
capacity = RoundUpToPowerOfTwo(NumCaptureTiles); valid count = NumCaptureTiles
gaps: Valid count is the compute pass dispatch count (NumCaptureTiles), not stored in the buffer.
RectIndex is 24 bits; a rect count above 2^24 would collide, which is far outside the atlas capacity.

resourceSchemas.quantity: last frame index at which each card page was sampled as a high-resolution (specular) page; 0 = never

fields.name: LastUsedHighResFrameIndex
fields.decode: SurfaceCacheUpdateFrameIndex written when the page is sampled through a high-res page; 0 when never used; consumer treats values in [now-2, now] as recently used

transforms.name: recentlyUsed
transforms.expression: bRecent = (LastUsed + 2 >= SurfaceCacheUpdateFrameIndex) && (LastUsed <= SurfaceCacheUpdateFrameIndex); used to force UpdateSpeed=4

mathTerms: capacity = NumCardPages allocation (1024 in this capture); only entries [0,NumCardPages) are valid
persistent buffer: cleared once at allocation, then written per sampled page; it is not cleared per frame
gaps: Frame index is a monotonic counter local to the Lumen surface-cache update; it cannot be converted to an absolute frame number without the capture's counter start.
A page that is never used keeps 0, which also equals 'used at frame 0'; the consumer's [now-2, now] test disambiguates at runtime but a static capture cannot.

resourceSchemas.quantity: two counters per card-update context: allocated card tiles total and allocated tiles in the selected max-priority bucket

fields.name: NumAllocatedTiles
fields.decode: context*2+0: running sum of NumCardPageTiles for pages reaching the total-budget check; includes pages later rejected when the budget would be exceeded

fields.name: NumAllocatedTilesInMaxBucket
fields.decode: context*2+1: running sum of NumCardPageTiles for pages in the selected max bucket, including pages rejected by the partial-bucket budget

transforms.name: allocatorIndex
transforms.expression: TilesTotal = Buffer[2*Context+0]; TilesInMaxBucket = Buffer[2*Context+1]

mathTerms: CARD_UPDATE_CONTEXT_MAX=2, CARD_PAGE_TILE_ALLOCATOR_STRIDE=2 => 4 uint32 total
values are tile counts, not page counts; GetNumCardPageTiles = SizeInTexels.x*SizeInTexels.y/64
gaps: The allocator is only a bookkeeping counter; source has no read of it other than the clear pass, so it cannot be used to reconstruct which pages were updated (CardPageIndexData holds that list).

resourceSchemas.quantity: total number of card tiles in the current spliced card-tile list (one counter, reset per producer pass)

fields.name: NumCardTiles
fields.decode: running count incremented per spliced 8x8 tile; consumers dispatch over [0,NumCardTiles)

transforms.name: dispatchCount
transforms.expression: NumCardTiles = Buffer[0]; record 0 = ceil(NumCardTiles/64) groups; record 1 = NumCardTiles groups

mathTerms: the same RDG name is produced in two contexts: LumenSceneDirectLighting.cpp:386 (direct lighting) and LumenRadiosity.cpp:729 (radiosity); the count refers to the card tiles of whichever pass wrote it, so a pass-context-free decode is ambiguous
gaps: Shared name across direct-lighting and radiosity contexts; the value is valid only within the pass that produced it (no passNameRegex restriction is applied to avoid false negatives).
The counter does not encode a capacity; the related CardTiles buffer is allocated with MaxLightTiles/MaxCardTiles, and unused tail entries are not valid.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-card-tile min/max surface-cache depth, used to tighten light culling
resourceSchemas.units: normalized card depth (two IEEE fp16 bit patterns)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: card space depth [0,1] (0=near, 1=far as used by GetCardLocalPosition)

storage.format: uint32: fp16 min in bits[0:15], fp16 max in bits[16:31]

fields.name: MinDepthFp16
fields.decode: f32tof16(min depth) in bits[0:15]; 0.0 when no valid texel

fields.name: MaxDepthFp16
fields.decode: f32tof16(max depth) in bits[16:31]; 1.0 when no valid texel

transforms.name: decodeRange
transforms.expression: Min = f16tof32(Packed & 0xFFFF); Max = f16tof32(Packed >> 16); if culling disabled: (0,1)

mathTerms: values are half-precision encodings of the float depth, not unorm16 integers
per-card-tile reduction: min/max over 64 texels; invalid texels are skipped and defaults are 0/1
capacity = MaxLightTiles of the direct-lighting update context (8281 in this capture); entries beyond CardTileAllocator[0] are stale
gaps: Only produced when r.LumenScene.DirectLighting.CullToTileDepthRange != 0; otherwise the buffer is allocated with 1 element and the decode must return (0,1).
The packed half floats are not a continuous fixed-point range; decode with f16tof32, not /65535.

resourceSchemas.quantity: card-page tile counts per priority bucket for each update context
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: priority bucket index [0,15] within context {direct=0, indirect=1}

fields.name: BucketTileCount
fields.decode: index = Context*16 + Bucket; value = sum of GetNumCardPageTiles over pages in that bucket; buckets are ordered most-important first (bucket 0)

transforms.name: selectBucket
transforms.expression: Accumulate buckets from 0 until sum >= MaxTilesToUpdate; the last bucket is partially consumed and its remaining tile budget is stored in MaxUpdateBucket[context*2+1]

mathTerms: 32 uint32 total = 2 contexts x 16 buckets
counts are tile counts (page size/64), not page counts
cleared before the histogram pass (LumenSceneLighting.usf:81)
gaps: The histogram alone does not identify pages; CardPageIndexData is the per-context selected list.
Bucket index derivation uses log2 and view distance/feedback; it is not stored, so the original priority value cannot be recovered exactly.

resourceSchemas.quantity: selected max priority bucket and the tile budget remaining in that bucket, per update context

fields.name: BucketIndex
fields.decode: context*2+0: last bucket selected (all lower buckets are fully updated)

fields.name: BucketMaxTiles
fields.decode: context*2+1: number of tiles that may still be allocated from the selected bucket

transforms.name: decode
transforms.expression: MaxBucket = Buffer[2*Context+0]; MaxTiles = Buffer[2*Context+1]

mathTerms: MAX_UPDATE_BUCKET_STRIDE=2, CARD_UPDATE_CONTEXT_MAX=2 => 4 uint32

if no bucket reaches the tile budget, BucketIndex stays 16 and BucketMaxTiles stays MaxTilesToUpdate; actual page buckets are 0..15, so no page matches the max-bucket partial test and only the total tile limit applies
gaps: BucketMaxTiles is a budget, not the number actually allocated; the actual allocated count is in CardPageTileAllocator[2*context+1].

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-screen-tile surface-cache feedback request: desired card page/res level and local page coordinates; element 0 is written only when a jittered tile is sampled
resourceSchemas.units: card index, res level, page coordinate, later a hit count

storage.format: uint2 (2 x uint32, 8 B) per screen tile

fields.name: DesiredResLevel
fields.decode: PackedA bits[24:31]; clamped log2(sample resolution)+res-level bias to [MinResLevel,MaxResLevel]

fields.name: LocalPageX
fields.decode: PackedB bits[0:7]: local page X at the desired res level

fields.name: PageHitNum
fields.decode: PackedB bits[16:31]: hit count; producer writes 0 here (the count is accumulated by the hash-table compaction into CompactedFeedback)

transforms.name: gatherWrite
transforms.expression: If (DitherScreenCoord & TileWrapMask) == TileJitter and SampleWeightSum > 0.1: WriteOffset = InterlockedAdd(Allocator[0],1); if WriteOffset < BufferSize: Buffer[WriteOffset] = PackedFeedback

transforms.name: decode
transforms.expression: CardIndex = A & 0xFFFFFF; DesiredResLevel = A>>24; LocalPage = (B&0xFF, (B>>8)&0xFF)

mathTerms: 8 B per element = 2 uint32
capacity = ceil(SceneExtentX/TileSize)*ceil(SceneExtentY/TileSize) screen tiles (4480 in this capture => 35,840 B)
only the first FeedbackAllocator[0] elements are written; the buffer is cleared to 0 at allocation
gaps: The producer writes only at one jittered texel per screen tile per frame, so most screen tiles have no fresh element in a given frame; element order is the atomic InterlockedAdd order, not screen order.
PageHitNum is not a per-frame hit count in this buffer; it becomes the deduplicated count only in Lumen.CompactedFeedback.

resourceSchemas.quantity: number of feedback elements written into Lumen.Feedback in the current frame

fields.name: NumWritten
fields.decode: InterlockedAdd per written feedback element; clamped by the hash-table indirect dispatch with min(NumWritten, FeedbackBufferSize)

transforms.name: dispatchBound
transforms.expression: NumHashElements = min(Buffer[0], FeedbackBufferSize); groups = ceil(NumHashElements/64)

mathTerms: cleared to 0 before the tracing passes that append feedback
gaps: A value larger than FeedbackBufferSize is possible because the atomic increments are clamped only by the per-write check; consumers must min() it (as the hash-table indirect args do).

resourceSchemas.quantity: header count plus one deduplicated feedback element per unique (card,res,page) request, with the hit count in the high 16 bits of word 1
resourceSchemas.units: count; card index; res level; page coordinate; hits

storage.format: uint2 (8 B); word 0 of element 0 is the unique-element count, element 0 is not a request

fields.name: UniqueElementCount
fields.decode: element 0 .x: number of unique elements written (the element-0 .y is unused)

fields.name: CardIndex
fields.decode: element[(i+1)*2+0] bits[0:23]: copied from the first feedback element of the bucket

fields.name: DeduplicatedHitCount
fields.decode: element[(i+1)*2+1] bits[16:31] = HashTableElementCounts value << 16 (overwrites the producer's zero PageHitNum field)

transforms.name: compact
transforms.expression: For each non-empty hash bucket: WriteOffset = InterlockedAdd(Buffer[0].x,1)+1; if WriteOffset < Size: Buffer[WriteOffset] = Feedback[ElementIndex]; Buffer[WriteOffset].y |= ElementCount<<16

transforms.name: readback
transforms.expression: Num = Data[0]; for i in [0,Num): A = Data[(i+1)*2+0]; B = Data[(i+1)*2+1]

mathTerms: capacity = RoundUpToPowerOfTwo(clamp(r.LumenScene.SurfaceCache.Feedback.UniqueElements,1,16384)) = 1024 in this capture (8192 B)
element 0 is a header; valid requests are [1, 1+min(count,size-1))
count in .y is 16 bits and is not clamped by the shader; the readback side clamps DesiredResLevel and page coords
gaps: The hit count is a count of raw feedback writes for the bucket, including duplicates and out-of-screen jitter writes; it is not a filtered visibility count.
At most one element is stored per hash bucket; hash collisions with different keys increment the same bucket (see HashTable keys gap), so the count is an upper bound for the first element's request.
The compacted array is ordered by hash-table bucket index, not by screen position or priority.

resourceSchemas.quantity: Murmur hash keys of feedback elements for linear-probing deduplication; 0 marks an empty slot

fields.name: Key
fields.decode: MurmurMix(A) combined with B via MurmurAdd for 2-uint feedback; 0 = empty slot; non-zero = key stored by the first element that claimed the bucket

transforms.name: hash
transforms.expression: Key = MurmurAdd(MurmurMix(PackedFeedback.x), PackedFeedback.y); Bucket = (Key + ProbeStep) & (2*CompactedSize-1), up to 32 steps

mathTerms: HashTableSize = 2 * CompactedFeedbackBufferSize (2048 in this capture)
probe sequence is Key, Key+1, ... (linear); max 32 steps then the element is skipped
empty slots are cleared to 0 before the build
gaps: The hash is not invertible: the original card/res/page request cannot be recovered from the key. Use HashTableElementIndices + Lumen.Feedback to recover it.
A true hash value of 0 is indistinguishable from an empty slot (source does not special-case it); the builder returns false but still increments the count at that bucket.

resourceSchemas.quantity: index of the first Lumen.Feedback element that claimed each hash bucket

fields.name: ElementIndex
fields.decode: written on first insertion only: ElementIndex of the feedback element whose hash claimed this bucket; contents stale/0 for empty buckets

transforms.name: lookup
transforms.expression: if Counts[bucket] > 0: Element = Feedback[Indices[bucket]]; feed its PackedA/PackedB into CompactedFeedback

mathTerms: HashTableSize = 2 * CompactedFeedbackBufferSize
not cleared before use (only Keys and Counts are cleared); entries for empty buckets are undefined and must not be read
gaps: Stale values for empty buckets are expected; gate on HashTableElementCounts > 0.

resourceSchemas.quantity: number of feedback writes that hashed into each bucket

fields.name: ElementCount
fields.decode: InterlockedAdd per feedback element; 0 = empty bucket; copied to CompactedFeedback[1+i].y bits[16:31]

transforms.name: copyCount
transforms.expression: if Count > 0: Compacted[1+i].y |= Count << 16

mathTerms: counts include all feedback writes for the bucket, so they can exceed the number of unique screen tiles (multiple frames/duplicates are not deduplicated beyond exact uint2 equality)
gaps: A non-empty bucket may represent several distinct requests if a 32-step probe insertion failed for a later key; source silently skips the add but still increments the bucket count.

resourceSchemas.quantity: single dispatch-indirect record for the feedback hash-table build

formatAlternatives: platform dispatch-argument padding: 16 B when PLATFORM_DISPATCH_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT_BOUNDARY_SIZE==64, 32 B when ==128 (RHI.h:551-557); 12 B on this desktop capture

transforms.name: dispatch
transforms.expression: GroupCount = ceil(min(Allocator[0], FeedbackBufferSize)/64); DispatchIndirect(shader, Buffer, 0)

mathTerms: one 12-B record; the build shader's THREADGROUP_SIZE is 64
padding variants change the stride, not the field order
gaps: The recorded X is a group count for a 64-thread group size; do not read it as an element count.

resourceSchemas.quantity: two dispatch-indirect records for the current card-tile list: one thread per card tile and one group per card tile
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: dispatch argument space; names are enum ELumenDispatchCardTilesIndirectArgsOffset

transforms.name: recordOffset
transforms.expression: Record(i) = Buffer + i*12; record 0 = OneThreadPerCardTile, record 1 = OneGroupPerCardTile

transforms.name: dispatch
transforms.expression: NumCardTiles = CardTileAllocator[0]; both records derive from that single count

mathTerms: 2 records x 12 B = 24 B in this capture
record 0 uses a 64-thread group; record 1 uses one group per tile (the shader's group covers one tile)
gaps: Shared name is produced by both direct lighting (LumenSceneDirectLighting.cpp:412) and radiosity (LumenRadiosity.cpp:737); counts refer to the producing pass's card-tile list.

resourceSchemas.quantity: two dispatch-indirect records for the selected card-page index list: one thread per page and four groups per page (one per 8x8 quadrant of the page's tile grid)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: dispatch argument space; separate direct/indirect contexts

fields.name: ThreadPerPage_X
fields.decode: record 0 X = ceil(NumPageIndices/64); Y=Z=1; shader processes one page per thread

fields.name: ThreadPerTile_X
fields.decode: record 1 X = 4*NumPageIndices; Y=Z=1; 4 groups per page, each group 8x8 threads = one card tile per thread (16x16 tiles per 128x128 page)

transforms.name: recordOffset
transforms.expression: Record(i) = Buffer + i*12; 0=ThreadPerPage, 1=ThreadPerTile; NumPageIndices = CardPageIndexAllocator[0]

mathTerms: 2 records x 12 B = 24 B per context
4*NumPageIndices is a group count, not a thread count; with 8x8 threads/group it covers 256 card tiles/page
gaps: The direct and indirect variants have identical storage and meaning but independent counts; do not mix their records.

resourceSchemas.quantity: single draw-indirect record used to rasterize one quad per selected card page (resample/clear pass instances)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: draw argument space; separate direct/indirect contexts

fields.name: VertexCountPerInstance
fields.decode: 3 when GRHISupportsRectTopology, else 6 (one/two triangles per rect)

transforms.name: draw
transforms.expression: VertexCount = 3|6; Instances = NumPageIndices; draw the rect-rasterizer with the page-index buffer as instance data

mathTerms: one 16-B record per context
StartVertex/StartInstance are always 0 in source
gaps: The record is written by SetCardPageIndexIndirectArgsCS regardless of whether any page index exists; InstanceCount=0 means no draw.

resourceSchemas.quantity: number of card page indices selected for update in the current context

fields.name: NumPageIndices
fields.decode: InterlockedAdd once per selected page; consumed as the instance count and dispatch bound

transforms.name: bound
transforms.expression: for QuadIndex < Allocator[0]: CardPageIndex = Data[QuadIndex]

mathTerms: one uint32 per context
count is bounded by CardPageNum (the producer checks NextIndex < CardPageNum before storing)
gaps: Direct and indirect contexts each own a separate allocator; the count is not a page count of the whole scene.

resourceSchemas.quantity: compact list of card page indices selected for lighting update in the current context, in atomic allocation order

fields.name: CardPageIndex
fields.decode: page index written at NextIndex; valid [0,Allocator[0])

transforms.name: load
transforms.expression: CardPage = GetLumenCardPageData(Data[QuadIndex]); Card = GetLumenCardData(CardPage.CardIndex)

mathTerms: capacity = RoundUpToPowerOfTwo(NumCardPages) (64 in this capture)
order is the interlocked allocation order of BuildCardsUpdateListCS, not sorted by page index
one page appears at most once because the producer is one thread per page
gaps: Valid count is Allocator[0], not the buffer capacity; the tail is stale/uninitialized.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-gathered-light packed 144-B record with LWC world position, light parameters, type, IES/light-function indices and shadow-mask flags
resourceSchemas.units: world units (cm) for position/radius/length; linear light color; unitless scales; enum/indices
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: world space (double-float high/low split); rect-light atlas UV space for the atlas fields

fields.name: WorldPositionHigh
fields.decode: high part of the light world position (LWC)

fields.name: WorldPositionLow
fields.decode: low part of the light world position (LWC)

fields.name: Color
fields.decode: light color multiplied by the light's indirect lighting scale; exposure is applied later by InverseExposureLerp

fields.name: DiffuseAndSpecularScale
fields.decode: two fp16 values: bits[0:15] diffuse scale, bits[16:31] specular scale (PackRG16 / UnpackFloat2FromUInt)

fields.name: SpotAngles
fields.decode: copied verbatim from FLightRenderParameters::SpotAngles (spot cos/sin pair as produced by the light proxy)

fields.name: RectLightAtlasMaxLevel
fields.decode: max rect-light atlas mip level; clamped to >=0 before upload

fields.name: SinCosConeAngleOrRectLightAtlasUVScale
fields.decode: spot: (sin,cos) outer cone angle; rect: atlas UV scale

fields.name: LightFunctionAtlasIndex
fields.decode: bits[0:28] of the packed word = light-function atlas index

fields.name: bHasShadows
fields.decode: bit29: light casts dynamic shadows (used for DeferredLightData.ShadowedBits)

fields.name: bIsStandalone
fields.decode: bit30: !CanUseBatchedShadows(); selects the standalone shadow-mask path

fields.name: bHasShadowMask
fields.decode: bit31: light needs a per-texel shadow mask

fields.name: IESAtlasIndex
fields.decode: IES atlas index stored as a float

fields.name: InverseExposureBlend
fields.decode: blend factor for InverseExposureLerp on the light color

transforms.name: pack
transforms.expression: Word128 = (LightFunctionAtlasLightIndex & 0x1FFFFFFF) | (NeedsShadowMask ? 1<<31 : 0) | (!CanUseBatchedShadows ? 1<<30 : 0) | (bHasShadows ? 1<<29 : 0)

transforms.name: decode
transforms.expression: WorldPosition = DFHackToFloat(MakeDFVector3(High,Low)); DiffuseScale/SpecularScale = UnpackFloat2FromUInt(word60); bHasShadowMask = word128>>31; bIsStandalone = bit30; bHasShadows = bit29

mathTerms: 144 B = 9 float4; every field is 4-B aligned except the packed word128
DiffuseAndSpecularScale is two fp16 values, not two unorm16
bHasShadowMask is bit31 and bIsStandalone is bit30; the shader reads >>31 and BitFieldExtract(...,1,30) respectively
gaps: LWC high/low reconstruction is not byte-exact without the DF encode function.
IESAtlasIndex is stored in a float, so it is exact only up to float32 integer precision (small indices are exact).
Capture capacity 16 elements = RoundUpToPowerOfTwo(max(N,16)); it does not reveal NumGatheredLights, and elements >= N are uninitialized.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-light world-space influence sphere used for fast tile culling

transforms.name: cull
transforms.expression: CenterLocal = mul(Sphere.xyz - Card.Origin, Card.WorldToLocalRotation); bAffects = ComputeSquaredDistanceFromBoxToPoint(...) < Sphere.w^2

mathTerms: 16 B per light; capacity = RoundUpToPowerOfTwo(max(NumGatheredLights,16)) (16 in this capture)
radius is W (not the length of xyz)
gaps: Capacity is not the light count; only the first NumGatheredLights entries are uploaded.

resourceSchemas.quantity: flat list of (light, view, card tile) light tiles produced by BuildLightTilesCS before per-light compaction
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: global card-tile index + per-light slot space

storage.format: uint2 (8 B) per light tile; compaction packing

fields.name: CardTileIndex
fields.decode: word1 bits[0:23]: index into the current CardTiles/CardTileAllocator list

fields.name: CulledLightIndex
fields.decode: word1 bits[24:29]: rank of this light within the card tile (0 = most important)

fields.name: LightType
fields.decode: word1 bits[30:31]: 0 standalone, 1 point, 2 spot, 3 rect

transforms.name: pack
transforms.expression: Word0 = LightIndex | (ViewIndex<<28) | (bHasShadowMask<<31); Word1 = CardTileIndex | (CulledLightIndex<<24) | (LightType<<30)

transforms.name: unpack
transforms.expression: LightIndex = Word0 & 0x0FFFFFFF; ViewIndex = (Word0>>28)&7; bMask = Word0>>31; CardTile = Word1 & 0xFFFFFF; Culled = (Word1>>24)&0x3F; Type = Word1>>30

mathTerms: 8 B per tile
valid count = LightTileAllocator[0]; capacity = MaxCulledCardTiles = MaxLightsPerTile * MaxLightTiles (66,248 = 8 x 8,281 in this capture)
gaps: This packing is specific to the compaction pass; Lumen.DirectLighting.CompactedLightTiles and LightTilesPerCardTile use different bit layouts for the same uint2 size.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-card-tile list of (light, view, shadow-mask index) entries addressed through LightTileOffsetNumPerCardTile

storage.format: uint2 (8 B) per light entry; light-pass packing

fields.name: ShadowMaskIndex
fields.decode: word1: index into ShadowMaskTiles, or 0xFFFFFFFF when the light has no shadow mask

transforms.name: address
transforms.expression: Entry = LightTilesPerCardTile[ (LightTileOffsetNumPerCardTile[tile] & 0x00FFFFFF) + CulledLightIndex ]; ShadowMask = word1 != 0xFFFFFFFF ? word1 : none

mathTerms: 8 B per entry
the buffer is indexed by a per-card-tile offset, not by a global light-tile index
capacity = MaxCulledCardTiles
gaps: Only entries referenced by a valid LightTileOffsetNumPerCardTile are meaningful; the rest of the capacity is stale.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-light compacted list of (light, view, card page, tile coord) used by shadow-mask/RT shadow passes
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: card page + 16x16 tile grid within the page

storage.format: uint2 (8 B) per compacted light tile; shadow-mask packing

transforms.name: pack
transforms.expression: Word0 = LightIndex | (ViewIndex<<28); Word1 = CardPageIndex | (TileX<<24) | (TileY<<28); CardTile read via CardTiles[LightTile.CardTileIndex]

transforms.name: unpack
transforms.expression: CardPage = Word1 & 0xFFFFFF; Tile = ((Word1>>24)&0xF, (Word1>>28)&0xF)

mathTerms: 8 B per entry
valid range is [0, numCompactedLightTiles); the list is written per light slot and compacted by CompactLightTilesCS
gaps: The number of compacted entries is the sum of CompactedLightTileAllocatorPerLight; there is no single header count in this buffer.

resourceSchemas.quantity: total number of light tiles in Lumen.DirectLighting.LightTiles

fields.name: NumLightTiles
fields.decode: running count incremented by NumPackedLightSamples per card tile; bounds compaction and dispatch

transforms.name: dispatch
transforms.expression: NumTiles = Buffer[0]; DispatchLightTilesIndirectArgs record 0 = NumTiles, record 1 = ceil(NumTiles/64)

mathTerms: cleared to 0 before BuildLightTilesCS
capacity is independent of the LightTiles buffer capacity; overflow would write out of bounds, and the algorithm bounds MaxLightsPerTile per tile
gaps: The count is not clamped to the LightTiles capacity in the shader; capacity sizing relies on MaxLightsPerTile and MaxLightTiles.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per (slot, view) count of light tiles; slots are batched light types 0..2 and standalone/batched lights at slot 3+lightIndex
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: slot x view index space; slotIndex*NumViews+view

fields.name: NumLightTilesPerSlot
fields.decode: index = SlotIndex*NumViews + ViewIndex; SlotIndex = (bUseLightTilesPerLightType && LightType>0) ? LightType-1 : 3+LightIndex

transforms.name: slotIndex
transforms.expression: if batched and type-based: slot = LightType-1 (point=0, spot=1, rect=2); else slot = 3 + LightIndex (directional and standalone)

mathTerms: capacity = RoundUpToPowerOfTwo(NumBatchableLightTypes + NumGatheredLights) * NumViewOrigins = 4 in this capture
counts are per slot/view, not a global count
gaps: Slot assignment depends on bUseLightTilesPerLightType (r.LumenScene.DirectLighting.BatchShadows==2) and per-light CanUseBatchedShadows; the slot meaning is ambiguous without that permutation.

resourceSchemas.quantity: total number of per-card-tile light entries allocated in LightTilesPerCardTile

fields.name: NumAllocatedEntries
fields.decode: running count incremented by NumPackedLightSamples; used only to allocate offsets for LightTilesPerCardTile

transforms.name: offset
transforms.expression: CardLightTilesOffset = InterlockedAdd(Buffer[0], NumPackedLightSamples); packed into LightTileOffsetNumPerCardTile

mathTerms: one uint32
cleared before BuildLightTilesCS
no consumer read exists in source besides the atomic allocation; the per-tile offsets are in LightTileOffsetNumPerCardTile
gaps: Write-only in source (no shader reads this buffer); it is not a dispatch bound and cannot be used to reconstruct the list without LightTileOffsetNumPerCardTile.

resourceSchemas.quantity: prefix-sum base offset of each (slot, view) in the compacted per-light light-tile lists

fields.name: TileOffset
fields.decode: prefix sum over slots and views; the first slot starts at 0; each subsequent slot adds the previous slot's count

transforms.name: compactionBase
transforms.expression: CompactedIndex = TileOffset[Slot*NumViews+View] + InterlockedAdd(CompactedAllocator[Slot*NumViews+View],1)

mathTerms: prefix order: with USE_STANDALONE_LIGHT_INDICES, the standalone indices at slot 3+LightIndex; without it, all light indices at slot 3+LightIndex; then the three batched light-type slots, with views innermost
capacity = NumLightsRoundedUp
gaps: The order of slots is fixed by source but the standalone/batched split depends on the permutation; a decoder must reproduce the same loop order to interpret offsets.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-card-tile packed (offset, count) of its light entries in LightTilesPerCardTile
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: card-tile index (global list) -> per-card-tile light list

fields.name: LightTilesOffset
fields.decode: bits[0:23]: first entry index in LightTilesPerCardTile

fields.name: NumLightTiles
fields.decode: bits[24:31]: number of light entries for this card tile (<= MaxLightsPerTile <= 32)

transforms.name: decode
transforms.expression: Offset = Packed & 0xFFFFFF; Count = Packed >> 24; for c in [0,Count): LightTilesPerCardTile[Offset+c]

mathTerms: one uint32 per card-tile index (global list), capacity = MaxLightTiles (8281 in this capture)
0 means offset=0,count=0 (no lights) for cards that were processed; entries beyond CardTileAllocator[0] are stale
gaps: The count field is 8 bits although MaxLightsPerTile is clamped to 32; values >32 would be a packing violation, not a valid state.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per (slot, view) running count used to place entries during light-tile compaction

fields.name: CompactedCount
fields.decode: InterlockedAdd per compacted light tile; the returned value is added to LightTileOffsetsPerLight to place the entry

transforms.name: placement
transforms.expression: CompactedIndex = TileOffset[Slot*NumViews+View] + InterlockedAdd(Buffer[Slot*NumViews+View],1)

mathTerms: capacity = NumLightsRoundedUp
cleared before CompactLightTilesCS
gaps: Write-only in source; the total compacted count per slot must be recovered by summing this buffer after the pass, and no read site exists.

resourceSchemas.quantity: ascending list of gathered-light indices that need a standalone (non-batched) shadow mask

fields.name: LightIndex
fields.decode: gathered light index; iteration order defines the standalone part of LightTileOffsetsPerLight

transforms.name: iterate
transforms.expression: for BufferIndex in [0,NumStandaloneLights): LightIndex = StandaloneLightIndices[BufferIndex]

mathTerms: capture capacity is 1 element; the live count is NumStandaloneLights (a pass parameter) and is not stored in this buffer
built in ascending GatheredLights order (loop over scene lights); uploaded only when bUseStandaloneLightIndices
gaps: The list is not a compacted list of all lights; batched lights are absent and represented by type slots instead.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per compacted light tile, 64 shadow factors (one per card-tile texel) with a completeness bit; optionally colored 5+5+5+1
resourceSchemas.units: coverage [0,1] (factor/127) or RGB factor/31; complete flag
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: 8x8 card-tile texels; linear bit index x+8*y within the tile

storage.format: uint32 dwords; 16 dwords/tile (8-bit path, 64x8 bits) or 32 dwords/tile (16-bit colored path, 64x16 bits)
formatAlternatives: 16-bit colored: 5+5+5 RGB + 1 complete bit, SHADOW_MASK_RAY_BITS=16, SHADOW_FACTOR_BITS=15, 32 dwords/tile; selected by COLORED_LIGHT_FUNCTION_ATLAS / GetLightFunctionAtlasFormat()>0

fields.name: ShadowFactor
fields.decode: bits[0:6] of the texel's 8-bit field, decode = value/127; sample index = 8*(x+8y)

fields.name: bShadowFactorComplete
fields.decode: bit7 of the texel's 8-bit field: all shadow rays for this texel were traced

transforms.name: loadRay
transforms.expression: BitOffset = 8*(x+8*y); Dword = 16*CardTileIndex + BitOffset/32; Shift = BitOffset%32; Factor = (DwordValue>>Shift)&0x7F; Complete = (DwordValue>>(Shift+7))&1

mathTerms: one field per card-tile texel (64 per tile), not per texel-row
8-bit layout occupies 16 dwords/tile; 16-bit colored layout occupies 32 dwords/tile (the buffer is allocated Factor*16*MaxCulledCardTiles dwords)
bits are written by atomics; the complete bit marks a fully traced texel
gaps: The colored 16-bit layout is not represented as separate fields here: RGB 5/5/5 bits [0:4],[5:9],[10:14] and complete bit15 (LumenSceneDirectLighting.ush:48-54,78-88).
The buffer is not cleared; bits for texels not touched by a traced ray remain stale, and only the complete bit certifies coverage.
CardTileIndex is the compacted shadow-mask index (CompactedLightTileIndex), not the global card-tile index.

resourceSchemas.quantity: two dispatch-indirect records over the global light-tile list

transforms.name: recordOffset
transforms.expression: Record 0 = thread-per-tile; record 1 = 64-thread groups over the light-tile array; both from LightTileAllocator[0]

mathTerms: 2 records x 12 B
names Div1/Div64 describe the group size assumed by the consuming shader, not a division of the value
gaps: Values are only meaningful for the frame/pass that wrote them; the buffer is not persistent.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one dispatch-indirect record per (slot, view): number of light-tile threads for that slot

storage.format: FRHIDispatchIndirectParameters[NumLightsRoundedUp] (12 B per record; 4 x 12 B = 48 B in this capture)
formatAlternatives: 16/32-B record padding when PLATFORM_DISPATCH_INDIRECT_ARGUMENT_BOUNDARY_SIZE is 64/128 (RHI.h:551-557); the capture is 48 B for 4 records, so the desktop 12-B layout applies

transforms.name: perLight
transforms.expression: Record(PerViewLightIndex) X = PerLightDispatchFactor * LightTileAllocatorPerLight[PerViewLightIndex]; PerLightDispatchFactor = 2 if thread-group size 32 else 1

mathTerms: record count = NumLightsRoundedUp = RoundUpToPowerOfTwo(3+NumGatheredLights)*NumViewOrigins (4 in this capture)
each record is 12 B in source and in this capture (4 x 12 B = 48 B)
gaps: The capture stride (12 B) matches the source struct; platform padding could change the stride for other platforms.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one draw-indirect record per (slot, view) to rasterize that light's compacted tiles

transforms.name: perLight
transforms.expression: Record(PerViewLightIndex) = (VertexCount, LightTileAllocatorPerLight[PerViewLightIndex], 0, 0)

mathTerms: 16 B per record
record count = NumLightsRoundedUp (4 in this capture)
records for slots with no tiles have InstanceCount=0
gaps: Record count is NumLightsRoundedUp, not the number of gathered lights; extra records are zero-initialized by the indirect-buffer creation.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per radiosity probe trace texel: incoming radiance along the cone (or sky radiance) multiplied by CachedLightingPreExposure
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: probe tracing atlas: probeAtlasCoord*HemisphereProbeResolution + traceTexel; probeAtlasCoord = (physicalAtlasCoord + tileOffset) >> ProbeSpacingShift

transforms.name: store
transforms.expression: Radiance = trace lighting (or sky); if max > MaxRayIntensity*OneOverPreExposure: scale down; TraceRadianceAtlas[ProbeCoord*HemiRes + TraceTexel] = Radiance * CachedLightingPreExposure

transforms.name: index
transforms.expression: ProbeCoord = (CardPage.PhysicalAtlasCoord + TileCoord*RadiosityTileSize + CoordInTile) >> ProbeSpacingDivideShift; Texel = ProbeCoord*HemisphereProbeResolution + TraceTexelCoord

mathTerms: 4 B/texel R11G11B10; extent = ProbeTracingAtlasSize (4096x4096 in this capture)
this is radiance, not irradiance: the SH conversion divides by the sampling PDF (LumenRadiosity.usf:358-383)
stored pre-exposed by CachedLightingPreExposure (not View.PreExposure)
gaps: R11G11B10 hardware rounding is not modelled; byte-exact radiance requires the exact format conversion.
The 4096x4096 extent does not by itself reveal PhysicalAtlasSize, ProbeSpacing or HemisphereProbeResolution; tracing = (physical/spacing)*hemi, so multiple combinations fit.
Radiosity can be gated off (LumenRadiosity::IsEnabled); this capture contains the resource, so it ran, but per-view validity is not encoded in the texture.

resourceSchemas.quantity: spatially filtered, blue-noise-quantized copy of TraceRadianceAtlas, consumed by the SH conversion
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: same probe tracing atlas layout as Lumen.Radiosity.TraceRadianceAtlas

transforms.name: filter
transforms.expression: Radiance = (CenterWeight*Center + sum(neighborWeight*Neighbor))/TotalWeight; Filtered = QuantizeForFloatRenderTarget(Radiance, BlueNoiseScalar(coord, temporalIndex+1))

mathTerms: allocated transiently each radiosity pass, extent same as TraceRadianceAtlas (4096x4096 in this capture)
center weight 2, 4 or 13 neighbors depending on kernel-size permutation (LumenRadiosity.usf:271-307)
not persistent; it is consumed in the same pass by ConvertToSH
gaps: The blue-noise dither seed uses the probe tracing atlas coordinate and IndirectLightingTemporalIndex+1; without those the quantization is not reproducible.
The filter variant (kernel size, plane weighting, probe occlusion) is a runtime permutation not encoded in the texture.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-view compact list of radiosity tiles (card page + tile coordinate) selected for tracing
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: card page tile grid, scaled by RadiosityTileSizeInProbes/ProbeSpacing when spacing==4

storage.format: uint32 per tile (MaxRadiosityTiles per view origin)

transforms.name: pack
transforms.expression: Packed = CardPageIndex | (TileX<<22) | (TileY<<27); index = ViewIndex*MaxRadiosityTiles + NextTileIndex

transforms.name: unpack
transforms.expression: CardPageIndex = Packed & 0x3FFFFF; TileX = (Packed>>22)&0x1F; TileY = (Packed>>27)&0x1F

mathTerms: 4 B per tile; capacity = MaxRadiosityTiles*NumViewOrigins (16,384 in this capture)
MaxRadiosityTiles = MaxCardTiles * (CardTileSize/RadiosityTileSize)^2; when ProbeSpacing==4 a radiosity tile is one probe and TileCoord is scaled by CardTileSizeInProbes
the 22-bit page index caps pages at 4,194,304 (far above the 128-texel page atlas)
gaps: Valid count is RadiosityTileAllocator[ViewIndex] (per view), not stored in this buffer; the rest of each view's MaxRadiosityTiles slice is stale.

resourceSchemas.quantity: number of radiosity tiles allocated for each view origin

fields.name: NumTiles
fields.decode: InterlockedAdd per emitted radiosity tile; used as the tile count for dispatch and as the read bound

transforms.name: count
transforms.expression: Count(View) = Buffer[View]; GetRadiosityTile(i) valid for i < Count(View)

mathTerms: one uint32 per view origin (1 element in this capture)
cleared before BuildRadiosityTilesCS
the buffer is separate from Lumen.CardTileAllocator, which counts card tiles before per-probe splitting
gaps: Count is per view; a multi-view capture has NumViewOrigins entries and they are not interchangeable.

resourceSchemas.quantity: four dispatch-indirect records per view origin: trace/thread-per-probe counts for the radiosity trace, filter and SH passes
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: dispatch argument space; each view origin owns 4 consecutive records

formatAlternatives: platform padding (RHI.h:551-557); the capture is 4 x 12 B = 48 B, so no padding here

fields.name: HardwareRayTracing_X
fields.decode: record 3: 2D/3D wrapped hardware-RT dispatch: X=ceil(NumTraces/HRTGroupSize) unless >4096, then X=HRTGroupSize and Y=ceil(X/HRTGroupSize), etc.; Y/Z then carry the wrap

transforms.name: recordOffset
transforms.expression: Base = ViewIndex*4; record i at Base+i (i=0..3): NumTracesDiv64, NumTracesDiv32, ThreadPerProbe, HardwareRayTracingThreadPerTrace

transforms.name: counts
transforms.expression: NumProbes = RadiosityTileAllocator[View] * RadiosityTileSizeInProbes^2; NumTraces = NumProbes * NumTracesPerProbe

mathTerms: 4 records x 12 B per view origin
record 3 is not a plain 1D dispatch: GetRayTracingThreadCountWrapped rewrites X/Y/Z for >4096 groups
record 0/1 differ only by assumed thread-group size (64/32)
gaps: Record 3's wrapped dimensions cannot be inverted to a 1D trace count without knowing HardwareRayTracingThreadGroupSize and the wrap rule.

resourceSchemas.quantity: transient card-capture atlas holding pre-exposed direct irradiance resampled from the previous surface cache for newly captured pages

formatAlternatives: PF_FloatRGBA / PF_A32B32G32R32F when r.Lumen.LightingDataFormat selects them

transforms.name: resample
transforms.expression: For each capture tile texel: CardIndex = NewCardPageResampleData[RectIndex*2].x; if valid: sample DirectLightingAtlas at old CardSample.PhysicalAtlasUV; else 0; write to RectCoord.xy + TexelCoordInRect

transforms.name: consume
transforms.expression: FLumenCardCopyPS reads DirectLightingCardCaptureAtlas at AtlasUV and writes it into Lumen.SceneDirectLighting

mathTerms: same size as the card-capture atlas (512x512 in this capture)
clear value is green (0,1,0,1): texels outside any rasterized rect keep the sentinel, so a zero/green value is not automatically valid data
values are already pre-exposed irradiance; do not multiply by CachedLightingPreExposure again
gaps: Whether a texel was written depends on the rect rasterization; the green clear sentinel is not a per-texel validity flag.
R11G11B10 quantization and the source surface-cache format may differ (the source direct atlas can be a different GetLightingDataFormat choice).

resourceSchemas.quantity: transient card-capture atlas holding pre-exposed indirect (radiosity) irradiance resampled from the previous surface cache

transforms.name: resample
transforms.expression: Same rect/tile walk as direct; samples IndirectLightingAtlas (radiosity) at old CardSample.IndirectLightingPhysicalAtlasUV and writes to the rect; skipped when radiosity is disabled (buffer not allocated)

mathTerms: allocated only when bRadiosityEnabled (LumenSceneRendering.cpp:1663-1682)
clear value green sentinel like the direct atlas
units are irradiance, not radiance
gaps: Absent when radiosity is disabled; its presence in the capture only proves radiosity was enabled for that frame.
Same green-clear validity caveat as the direct resample atlas.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per card tile (8x8 texels): average number of accumulated radiosity frames, resampled from the previous surface cache
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: card-capture atlas tile grid (one texel per 8x8 tile)

fields.name: NumFramesAccumulated
fields.decode: stored = average(source .x) where source .x = frames/255; because R8 is UNORM, decode frames = code = stored*255 (1-frame quantization), not stored/255

transforms.name: average
transforms.expression: Read source RadiosityNumFramesAccumulatedAtlas.x (= frames/255), sum 64 tile texels, divide by 64, write to R8 UNORM; hardware stores round(avg_frames), so decoded frames = code

mathTerms: extent = CardCaptureAtlasSize/8 (64x64 in this capture)
PF_R8 is UNORM: stored 0..1 maps to code 0..255; the source deliberately stores frames/255 (LumenRadiosity.usf:501-506), so this texture's code is the average frame count
the average mixes valid and invalid texels; the source does not weight by validity for this average
gaps: The source per-texel frame count can be >1 and is averaged; the R8 code is the rounded average, so quantization is 1 frame (code), not 1/255 frame.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per card tile: 8 dwords of bits, one bit per (lightIndex & 255), set when the tile had uniform visibility to that light in the last lighting update
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: card-capture atlas tile grid; bit index = lightIndex & 255

storage.format: uint32[8] per card tile (32 B/tile; 4 B/dword)

fields.name: UniformVisibilityMask
fields.decode: DwordIndex = 8*TileIndex + (LightIndex&255)/32; bit (LightIndex&255)%32 = 1 if the whole tile had uniform visibility to that light; loaded as two uint4 words

transforms.name: read
transforms.expression: TileIndex = TileY*WidthInTiles + TileX; for LightIndex: Dword = 8*TileIndex + ((LightIndex&255)>>5); Bit = (LightIndex&255)&31; bUniform = (DwordValue>>Bit)&1

transforms.name: resampleMerge
transforms.expression: ShadowDownsampleFactor is AND-reduced across all 64 texels of the tile (wave/group reduction), then written once per tile

mathTerms: 8 dwords = 256 bits per tile; LightIndex is masked with 255, so lights with index >=256 alias earlier bits
capacity = (CardCaptureAtlasSize/8)^2 * 8 dwords = 4096*8 = 32,768 in this capture
the value is a visibility-uniformity hint, not a shadow factor
gaps: Light indices above 255 alias by the &255 mask; the bit does not identify the light uniquely.
The AND-reduction means a tile bit is set only if every texel's per-ray uniform-visibility flag was set; it is not a per-texel shadow value.
The consumer binding is the ResampledCardCaptureTileShadowDownsampleFactorAtlas read by FLumenCardCopyPS; it is a transient copy, not the persistent Lumen.TileShadowDownsampleFactorAtlas.
